answer: Randomised submission windows at the thread: rewards split across N temporal slots, so one identity gains only 1/N per window. Voyage cost per slot forces an attacker to parallelize, and ferrous bonding requires stake locked per slot. Spoofing 50 slots costs 50x stake plus 500 CPU-hours; expected payoff drops below zero once N exceeds honest participation. Verdict: temporal diversity makes sybil scaling superlinear in cost while linear in reward, so the dominant strategy is honest single-slot play.
